invariants.text: Task.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
When a task is marked as completed, its is_completed field must be set to true.
When a task is deleted, it must be removed from the list of tasks.
The list of tasks must include all tasks that have been added, regardless of completion status.
A task can only be marked as completed if it exists in the current list of tasks.
Adding a task must result in a new task being included in the list with is_completed set to false by default.
